how.title: How pricing works
how.lede: The price per piece depends on four things. Knowing them helps you budget and choose the best-value spec.

size.title: Size
size.body: A bigger box uses more board; a size that fits the print sheet well wastes less and costs less

material.title: Material
material.body: Paper grade, grammage and flute type decide both strength and cost

print.title: Print and finishing
print.body: Number of colours, one or two sides and special finishes; offset printing has a plate cost per set

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.body: Set-up costs are shared across the quantity: the more you order, the lower the price per piece

includes.dieline: Box templates are free to download

materials.title: Corrugated board materials
materials.lede: Material options of the instant-price products: the letters are the liner grade, the number is the grammage
materials.caption: Materials of the instant-price products

process.title: Process and timing
process.lede: Production time is counted in working days and shown on each product's card and page

choose.title: Choose product and spec
choose.body: Instant-price products show their price at once; made-to-spec items go into a quote request

pay.title: Send files and pay
pay.body: Upload your artwork or design it in the Studio, then pay the way that suits you

produce.title: Production
produce.body: We produce to your spec; follow the status on your order page
produce.tagRange: Instant price {min, number}–{max, number} working days

deliver.title: Delivery and guarantee
deliver.body: Delivered to your address; inspect and report issues under the work guarantee

services.title: Add-on services
services.lede: Order with your products or on their own; priced to the job

vat.a: Product prices include VAT but not shipping. Shipping is calculated from the delivery postcode when you order.

moq.a: It depends on the product; each item's minimum is shown on its card and in this page's price table.

lead.a: Instant-price products show their production time in working days; made-to-spec work has its timing in the quotation.

tolerance.q: Can the quantity delivered be slightly under or over?
tolerance.a: Printed work may be slightly under or over within print industry standards; see the work guarantee for details.

payment.a: Bank transfer, PromptPay QR and credit/debit card.

taxInvoice.q: Can I get a full tax invoice?
taxInvoice.a: Yes — a full tax invoice issued by {company}; enter your company details when you order.
taxInvoice.aNoName: Yes — a full tax invoice; enter your company details when you order.

mockup.q: Can I see a real sample before mass production?
mockup.a: Yes — order the “Real sample (mock-up)” service to check size, colour and print before a large order.

dieline.a: Yes — box templates are free to download from each product page.
